conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, this is Officer Paul Emerson, badge ID 4217. With whom am I speaking today?
Hello, this is Harold. I got a message saying I needed to call about an urgent tax issue?
Yes, Mr. Harold, thank you for responding so quickly. I have your case file here regarding an audit of your federal tax returns for the last five years.
Oh my goodness, I've always tried to pay my taxes on time. What's the problem?
According to our records, there are discrepancies and misreported income totaling $5,200. This has resulted in a serious tax evasion case against you.
Tax evasion? I just get my Social Security and a small pension. I don't understand.

Sir, the IRS takes these matters very seriously. Unfortunately, a federal warrant has already been generated under your name. If this is not resolved immediately, law enforcement may arrive at your residence within 24 hours.
Wait, what? Are you saying I could go to jail?
Yes, the charges carry potential jail time and government asset seizure, including your bank accounts and benefits. However, there is a way to prevent further action if you cooperate right now.
Please, I can't lose my money or my house. What do I need to do?

To cancel the arrest warrant today, you must make a tax settlement payment. Do not discuss this with anyone else, as your file is flagged for legal action. Can you confirm your current address and the last four digits of your Social Security number for verification?
I live at 123 Maple Lane, and the last four digits are 4491.

Thank you for verifying. Since this is an urgent matter, you must make the payment using government-approved methods only. Credit cards, checks, or cash are not accepted for flagged cases. Do you have access to a computer or smartphone, sir?
I have a phone but I don't use the computer much anymore.
That's fine. You'll need to visit a nearby store, such as Walmart, CVS, or Walgreens, and purchase federal-approved payment cards, specifically Apple or Google Play gift cards, for the total amount.
Gift cards? Are you sure that's how the IRS does this?

Sir, due to the flagged status of your case, traditional payments are frozen. Gift cards are the only acceptable method today to secure your file before the warrant is activated. You must act quickly.
I'm a little nervous. That's a lot of money. I only get so much each month.
This is your only opportunity to avoid jail and losing your Social Security benefits. How much can you afford to pay right now? Even a partial payment can delay the arrest.
I might be able to do $1,000 today. Maybe a bit more next month.
That will help for now. Please go to the store immediately and purchase $1,000 worth of Apple or Google Play gift cards. Stay on the line with me while you do so.
Alright, I can go to Walgreens. Do I just buy the cards and come back?

Yes, buy the cards and do not let the cashier know it's for the IRS, or your file could be further flagged. Once you have the cards, read me the numbers on the back so I can process your payment and suspend the warrant.
